It settled nothing on its own and it was WRONG at every one of the three letter-level sites in this range -- see _witness_finding.
_witness_finding: THE ARCHIVE COPY REPAIRED MIGNE THREE TIMES IN THIRTEEN COLUMNS. At 0277A it prints 'Sicut tibi' where the plate sets the fused 'Sicuttibi'; at 0283C it prints 'supra' where the plate sets 'snpra'; at 0284B it prints 'usque ad' where the plate sets 'uque ad'. In all three our Corpus Corporum twin agrees with the PLATE, not with the archive. Had the archive been treated as corroboration, three genuine defects of Migne's would have been withdrawn as our own digitization noise -- the exact inverse of the 0005-0009 finding, and the jbig2 symbol-substitution mechanism of PL113-WITNESS-ENCODING.md running in the repair direction. It also produced two false alarms of its own that cost a plate check each: 'Vers. 25' for VERS. 35 and 'lib. X Moral.' for lib. I Moral., both at 0285C, both refuted at the plate.
